title: Allow the governed precise OpenAPI writer to replace the canonical Brand-workspace predecessor

phases.objective: Recognize only the already-canonical Brand-workspace v2 tenant plugin resolve contract as a safe predecessor when the reviewed inline contract advances to Root Workspace plus explicit Brand scope, while preserving fail-closed rejection for partial, altered, or caller-widened predecessor shapes.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run openapi-precise-contract-registry-sync.mjs --write against an occupied tenant platform-plugin resolve path containing each supported predecessor fixture.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Legacy, workspace-only v2, and the exact canonical Brand-workspace v2 predecessor upgrade to the reviewed Root Workspace plus explicit Brand contract, while malformed predecessor variants remain conflicts and the resulting contract is idempotent in check mode.
steps: Construct the existing legacy and workspace-only predecessor fixtures and the canonical Brand-workspace v2 predecessor currently represented by the repository root OpenAPI contract.
Point the reviewed inline registry fragment at a Root Workspace contract carrying an explicit brand_ref and sanitized ownership scope references.
Run the precise registry writer and require the exact predecessor predicate before replacing the occupied inline path.
Verify the replacement equals the reviewed inline fragment and that a subsequent check reports no drift.
Submit malformed Brand, authority-source, enabled-Brand, security, operation, and version variants and require fail-closed path conflicts with no source mutation.
assertions: The canonical Brand-workspace predecessor is accepted only when its route, operation identity, runtime source, user JWT profile, security, contract version, owner-scope enum, Brand inclusion shape, and Brand authority-source enum exactly match the known v2 contract.
The accepted canonical predecessor has no caller brand_ref and exposes no owner_scope_ref or brand_ref in ownership evidence before the reviewed Root Workspace contract is composed.
The existing pre-Brand workspace-only predecessor remains supported without widening its predicate.
Partial or modified Brand predecessor shapes remain registered_path_inline_contract_not_replaceable conflicts.
The writer replaces only the registered tenant plugin resolve path, produces the exact reviewed inline contract, and remains idempotent in check mode.
No generated artifact is edited manually and no Production, database, secret, protected-ref, or force-push mutation is performed.
